objective: Fix the existing in-memory TTL cache invalidation and synchronous-loader-error defects only. Permitted changes: after clear(), pre-clear loaders must never repopulate the cache or remove a newer in-flight entry; after explicit set(key,B), older loaders for that key must never overwrite B, including after B expires. Both synchronous throws and asynchronous rejection must leave no rejected promise reused on the next request. Original callers of superseded loaders still receive their own original result/error; do not cancel or change that return contract. Replacement loaders remain deduplicated until their own completion. Preserve all other behavior: public exports/API, TTL constants and <= expiry boundary, LRU (get refreshes, peek does not), stale metadata, falsey cached values, undefined-as-miss, key identity, counters for unchanged paths, and clear retaining hit/miss counters. Do not change providers, persistence, schedules, shared-cache architecture, capacities or financial methodology. Only edit lib/serverCache.js and tests/serverCache.test.js. Add deterministic regression tests, preserving existing tests. No timers/sleeps for ordering: use manually resolved/rejected promises and a fixed/fake clock.
